description_en: Queries the configuration of a router interface
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-router-interface-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ri-m5egfc10sednwk2yt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRouterInterfaceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the router interface.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the router interface to query
parameters.name: instance_id

AccessPointId.description_en: The ID of the access point

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the router interface. Unit: Mbps

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the router interface. Valid values:

Normal: normal.

FinancialLocked: locked due to overdue payment.

SecurityLocked: locked due to security risk control
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
路由器接口状态。取值：

Normal：正常

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

SecurityLocked：安全风控锁定

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

AfterPay: pay-as-you-go.
PrePaid: subscription
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费方式。取值：

AfterPay：后付费
PrePaid：预付费

ConnectedTime.description_en: The time when the connection was established. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ConnectedTime.description_zh: 连接建立的时间。按ISO 8601标准表示，使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the router interface was created. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 路由器接口创建的时间。按ISO 8601标准表示，使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

CrossBorder.description_en:
Indicates whether this is a cross-border connection. Valid values:

false: No.

true: Yes
CrossBorder.description_zh:
是否是跨境连接。取值：

false：不是

true：是

Description.description_en: The description of the router interface

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the data retrieval. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 获取数据的结束时间点。按ISO 8601标准表示，使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

FastLinkMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the router interface on the VBR was created in fast link mode. Fast link mode allows the router interfaces on both the VBR and VPC sides to automatically connect after creation. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false (default): No.


This parameter takes effect only when RouterType is set to VBR and OppositeRouterType is set to VRouter.
When FastLinkMode is set to true, Role must be set to InitiatingSide, and AccessPointId, OppositeRouterType, OpppsiteRouterId, and OppositeInterfaceOwnerId are required
FastLinkMode.description_zh:
是否为使用快速连接模式创建的VBR上联路由器接口，快速连接模式可实现VBR和VPC两端路由器接口创建完毕后自动完成连接。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。


该参数只在RouterType取值为VBR，OppositeRouterType参数取值为VRouter时生效。
当FastLinkMode参数取值为true时，Role参数必须取值为InitiatingSide，AccessPointId、OppositeRouterType、OpppsiteRouterId和OppositeInterfaceOwnerId参数为必选

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the router interface was last modified
GmtModified.description_zh: 路由器接口修改的时间点

HasReservationData.description_en:

HcRate.description_en: The health check rate. Unit: seconds. This value indicates the interval between consecutive probe packets sent during a health check
HcRate.description_zh: 健康检查速率。单位：秒。表示指定健康检查时发送连续探测报文的时间间隔

HcThreshold.description_en: The health check threshold. This value indicates the number of probe packets sent during a health check. Unit: packets
HcThreshold.description_zh: 健康检查阈值。表示指定健康检查时发送探测报文的个数。单位：个

HealthCheckTargetIp.description_en: The health check target IP address

Inactive: frozen.
Deleting: being deleted.
Deleted: deleted
